title: MV RPG Maker MV is constantly crashing, AMD driver is at issue

posts.author: Jacie0krece
posts.body:
Hello,
I recently bought and downloaded RPG Maker MV to collaborate on a project, but it has an unimaginably high amount of crashes - every as often as few minutes, even.
As visible in this Event Viewer screenshot, it is related to graphics - more specifically the AMD driver. Updating didn't solve the problem, neither did telling Windows to use the integrated graphics with MV:
Or just straight-up updating the nw.js to 49.2 (which is newer than MZ's btw, at least in my case - yet MZ didn't crash on me ever, and definitely not this often).
It happens regardless of the project, and mostly affects the editor itself - I didn't manage to make the playtest to crash in this way ever (and the closest was probably the editor crashing while the playtest is running). However, rapidly clicking things around seems to quicken the crash - even though the editor can also crash when left idle.
The crash also just makes MV hang and then quit to desktop, with the only info about the crash showing up in the Event Viewer.
My graphics card info, copied straight from the Task Manager:

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Just taking a blind shot here, but did you try monitoring the RAM usage via task manage while using MV? WIndows 11 had the issue for a while now that the RAM usage would simply keep increasing until the programm crashes. I know you've mentioned the GPU driver, but I can neither read russian, nor do I see why that would be a problem.
EIther way it's worth checking out.

posts.author: Jacie0krece
posts.body:
Nope, I reproduced the crash a few times with the Task Manager open to monitor MV's RAM usage, and the memory usage barely got to above 300MB before it crashes. (Not only do I have 32 GB of RAM on my system, only half of which is used right now, but I would expect an 32-bit program to run out of memory at 2, maybe 4 GB, not 300 megabytes).
Also it reminds me of a similar "driver acting up" problem I had with osu!stable years back on my old PC. (which runs absolutely fine on my current PC though). And even that, it was more of osu! straight-up refusing to run, rather than it crashing after a short while like MV does.
(also it's not Russian it's Polish...)
